# LagFactory 2

**Description:**
LagFactory 2 is a fully modded Fabric 1.20.1 experience that redefines exploration, survival, and creativity in Minecraft. Packed with content, from world generation overhauls to advanced building tools and combat enhancements, this modpack provides a deep, engaging, and unpredictable sandbox experience.

---

## 🌍 World & Exploration

* Expansive terrain generation with **Biomes O’ Plenty**, **Terralith**, **Oh The Biomes We’ve Gone**, and **Yung’s Worldgen Mods**.
* Hundreds of new structures, dungeons, temples, and hidden locations to discover.
* Dynamic biomes and seasons for realistic and immersive gameplay (**Fabric Seasons**, **Nature’s Delight**, **Nature’s Spirit**).

---

## ⚔️ Combat & Survival

* Enhanced combat mechanics with **Better Combat**, **Simply Swords**, and **Enchantments Plus**.
* Boss encounters, challenging mobs, and diverse dungeon experiences.
* Survival enhancements including **Diet**, **AppleSkin**, **Farmers Delight**, and **Elytra Slot**, adding strategy, realism, and convenience to your adventures.

---

## 🏗️ Building & Creativity

* Advanced building and automation with **Create**, **Create Additions**, **Create Big Cannons**, and **Create Structures**.
* Expanded aesthetic options via **Rechiseled**, **Twigs**, **Structory**, and **Better Stats**.
* Full creative freedom for builders, engineers, and redstone enthusiasts.

---

## ⚙️ Quality of Life & Utilities

* Smooth gameplay improvements with **Better F3**, **Clumps**, **Smooth Swapping**, **Inventory Management Mods**, and **FirstPerson**.
* Enhanced item and block interactions, tooltips, and UI features for seamless play.
* Player-centric mods like **Better Third Person**, **Camera Overhaul**, and **Held Item Info** for immersive perspectives.

---

## 🎯 Features at a Glance

* Fully modded world generation with diverse biomes and structures
* Overhauled combat and enchantment systems
* Deep survival mechanics and realistic character management
* Extensive building, automation, and creative tools
* Optimizations and QoL improvements for smoother gameplay

---

## 💻 Recommended Hardware

| **Component** | **Minimum**                | **Recommended**                 | **Notes**                                                       |
| :-----------: | :------------------------: | :-----------------------------: | :-------------------------------------------------------------: |
| **CPU**       | Quad-core                  | 8-core+                         | High single-core speed helps mods like Create and worldgen mods |
| **RAM**       | 16 GB                      | 32 GB                           | Fabric + many mods + worldgen-heavy biomes can eat memory fast  |
| **GPU**       | GTX 1050 / RX 560          | RTX 2060 / RX 6700 XT or higher | Needed for shaders, smooth FPS, and rendering complex builds    |
| **Storage**   | HDD                        | SSD                             | SSD drastically reduces load times and worldgen lag             |
| **Java**      | Java 21                    | Java 21                         | Keep it updated for best Fabric + mod compatibility             |
| **OS**        | Windows 10 / macOS / Linux | Latest versions recommended     | Stability & driver support matter                               |

---

LagFactory 2 isn’t just a modpack—it’s a **complete Minecraft sandbox odyssey**, combining chaos, creativity, and depth in a single experience. Explore, build, fight, and survive in a world where every session feels fresh and alive.
